;пример рекурсивного макроса by ACi8 oct'05
mstack=#C000
        MACRO push
mstack=mstack-2
        ORG mstack
        DW \0
        ENDM

        MACRO pop
\0={mstack}
mstack=mstack+2
        ENDM

        MACRO fibo
a=\0
       IF0 \0-2<1&1
        fibo \0-1
        push a
        fibo \0-2
        pop x
a=a+x
       ENDIF
        ENDM

        fibo 6
        DISPLAY a
        fibo 5
        DISPLAY a
        fibo 4
        DISPLAY a
        fibo 3
        DISPLAY a
        fibo 2
        DISPLAY a
        fibo 1
        DISPLAY a
        fibo 0
        DISPLAY a
